name: @schoolos/content-studio
description: SchoolOS Content Studio (roadmap §5.3, PR C03): SSRF-guarded URL import and magic-byte-checked uploads into quarantine, rights modes, deterministic and AI-assisted review reports, a reviewer queue, immutable resource releases, Blueprint release ingest, and a Durable Object SQLite store through its `./durable-object-store` entry point. A library, not a deployable Worker.
